design_style.name: WoodNest Glassmorphism
design_style.direction: premium nature retreat + modern real-estate booking
design_style.reference: Combine the information architecture and functionality of the previous real-estate app with the translucent, atmospheric visual language of the provided WoodNest inspiration.
principles: glassmorphism as the dominant visual language
nature photography used as an active background layer
premium, calm, warm and contemporary appearance
earthy palette instead of the previous saturated blue real-estate style

heading.usage: hero titles, section headings, major prices, prominent labels

body.usage: body text, navigation, metadata, forms, buttons and secondary information

rules: Use Anton sparingly for high-impact hierarchy.
Use Quicksand for almost all interface text.
Do not use additional decorative fonts.
Maintain generous line-height in large hero text.
Use uppercase Anton selectively for compact labels.

F0EAD2.name: Cream
F0EAD2.role: primary light surface, primary CTA, text on dark photographic backgrounds

DDE5B6.name: Pale Sage
DDE5B6.role: secondary glass tint, soft highlights, selected states

ADC178.name: Sage Green
ADC178.role: accent, active controls, status indicators, icons

A98467.name: Warm Taupe
A98467.role: secondary accent, borders, warm UI details

6C584C.name: Deep Brown
6C584C.role: primary dark text, dark surfaces, navigation and contrast

rules: Glass must remain translucent enough to reveal the image behind it.
Use backdrop blur instead of opaque white cards.
Use thin light borders to define glass edges.
Avoid excessive blur that destroys the photographic context.
Dark glass may be used when the background is very bright.
Light cream glass may be used over dark forest photography.

imagery.subject: premium cabins, lodges, forests, mountains, retreats and nature
treatment: background images may extend behind glass cards
avoid: bright blue skies dominating the interface

structure: bottom navigation contained in a translucent glass bar
layout.alignment: strong left alignment for editorial content with centered controls where appropriate

components.navbar: transparent or glass floating navigation with logo and minimal menu icon
components.hero: full-screen nature image with large Anton headline and Quicksand supporting copy
components.propertyCard: photographic image, glass information overlay, price, rating, location and CTA
components.search: floating glass search field with rounded filters
components.filters: small translucent pills using Cream, Pale Sage and Sage Green
components.primaryButton: Cream filled button with Deep Brown text
components.secondaryButton: transparent glass button with Cream or Deep Brown text depending on background
components.bookingPanel: large translucent panel with date, guests, price and reserve action
components.bottomNavigation: floating glass bar with Home, Search, Saved and Profile
components.profile: soft glass panels with simple line icons and restrained accent color
components.badges: small rounded glass chips with Sage Green accents

iconography.avoid: heavy filled icons and overly playful icon sets

states.disabled: reduced opacity without introducing new colors

design_style.overall_instruction: Redesign the existing real-estate app without changing its core booking and property-discovery functionality. Replace the previous blue/gold Jetpack-Compose promotional aesthetic with the WoodNest glassmorphic visual system: cinematic nature imagery, translucent blurred surfaces, earthy cream/sage/taupe/brown palette, Anton for display typography and Quicksand for interface text. The final result should feel like a premium nature-retreat product rather than a conventional real-estate marketplace.
